editorNote: Monday's session: Chinese tech and Alphabet bounce, gold lifts from a one-year low, and a second exchange hack tests crypto. The items draw on headlines and summaries from the sources linked; follow them for detail. Nothing here is investment advice.

stories.headline: Alibaba, JD.com and PDD climb on Monday after a brutal October for Chinese stocks, Benzinga reports
stories.summary: Benzinga reports that Alibaba, JD.com and PDD stocks rose on Monday following a rough October for Chinese equities.
stories.whyItMatters: Alibaba, a watchlist holding, was part of a broad Monday rebound in US-listed Chinese stocks after the prior month's weakness.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba, JD.com, PDD Stocks Climb Monday After Brutal October for Chinese Stocks: What’s Going On? - Benzinga

stories.headline: Gold rises more than 1% from a one-year low as oil softens and US midterms loom, Reuters reports
stories.summary: Reuters reports spot gold gained over 1% from a one-year low, helped by softer oil prices, with US midterm elections in focus.
stories.whyItMatters: The bounce comes off the lowest gold price in a year, which earlier editions have tracked below $4,000.

sourceLinks.title: Gold rises over 1% from one-year low on softer oil prices; US midterms in focus - Reuters

stories.headline: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million is drained across 10 chains; it says it will absorb the loss
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports Mercado Bitcoin halted withdrawals after about $40 million was drained across 10 blockchains; Bloomberg reports the exchange says it will absorb the $40 million loss.
stories.whyItMatters: A second exchange hack in a week, following Binance's, puts custody security back in focus for crypto holders.

sourceLinks.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains - CoinDesk
Mercado Bitcoin Says It Will Absorb $40 Million Loss From Hack - Bloomberg.com

stories.headline: Bitcoin edges up after the Binance hack while Coinbase keeps falling; Barron's asks why crypto is shrugging it off
stories.summary: Investor's Business Daily reports bitcoin edged higher after the Binance hack while Coinbase shares kept falling. Barron's headlines a piece on why bitcoin, XRP and other cryptos are shrugging off the $6 billion hack.
stories.whyItMatters: Spot prices have so far absorbed the hack more calmly than the exchange-linked equity, Coinbase.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Edges Up After Binance Hack, But Coinbase Keeps Falling - Investor's Business Daily
Why Bitcoin, XRP, Cryptos Are Shrugging Off the $6 Billion Binance Hack - Barron's

stories.headline: Alphabet shares climb Monday, after Morningstar called Friday's drop the stock's worst day in history
stories.summary: Investing.com asks 'Why is Alphabet stock climbing today?' on Monday; Morningstar's markets brief called the prior drop Alphabet's worst day in history and flagged signs of strain across the AI trade.
stories.whyItMatters: Alphabet is moving higher on Monday after the record one-day decline covered in earlier editions.

sourceLinks.title: Why is Alphabet stock climbing today? - Investing.com
Markets Brief: Alphabet Stock’s Worst Day in History, Signs of Strain Across the AI Trade - Morningstar

stories.headline: Citizens reiterates its Rocket Lab rating, citing the Neutron delay
stories.summary: Investing.com reports Citizens reiterated its rating on Rocket Lab stock, citing the delay to the Neutron rocket.
stories.whyItMatters: Neutron's slip to 2027, covered earlier, continues to shape analyst commentary on Rocket Lab.

sourceLinks.title: Citizens reiterates Rocket Lab stock rating citing Neutron delay - Investing.com

stories.headline: Evercore ISI reiterates its Duolingo rating on user growth as Q3 earnings approach
stories.summary: Investing.com reports Evercore ISI reiterated its Duolingo rating, pointing to user growth. GuruFocus, via Yahoo Finance, lists Duolingo's Q3 2026 report among earnings to watch.
stories.whyItMatters: Duolingo's Q3 results are upcoming, and analyst commentary is focused on user growth.

sourceLinks.title: Evercore ISI reiterates Duolingo stock rating on user growth - Investing.com
Earnings To Watch: Duolingo Inc (DUOL) Q3 2026 -- GF Value Sees 250% Upside - GuruFocus

stories.headline: Kinross earnings: a stronger gold price outweighs lower volumes and higher unit costs, Morningstar says
stories.summary: Morningstar's note on Kinross's results says the stronger gold price more than compensated for lower volumes and higher unit costs.
stories.whyItMatters: A gold miner's quarter shows the higher average price offsetting weaker operating metrics.

sourceLinks.title: Kinross Earnings: Stronger Gold Price More Than Compensates for Lower Volumes and Higher Unit Costs - Morningstar
